title: JSON parameter conformance levels and actionable error envelope
creator: Amelia Park
description: Problem: our current function/tool-call validation returns vague failure strings or large JSON Schema dumps that are hard for SDKs and integrators to act on. This makes it difficult for customers to recover from simple mistakes (type mismatch, missing optional fields) and for client SDKs to surface actionable remediation. Goal: design and implement a compact, machine- and human-friendly error envelope and a conformance model with two validation modes (lenient/strict). Deliver a runtime compatibility shim that can auto-repair common issues and expose telemetry to evaluate repair safety. This ticket covers design decisions, runtime implementation, SDK contract, and rollout plan.
acceptance_criteria: Define conformance-level metadata to attach to tool/function JSON schemas (lenient, recommended, strict)
Implement server-side validator that emits an error envelope with: error_code, field_path, expected, actual, severity, suggested_fix (string), and machine_tags (list)

Add an opt-in runtime auto-repair layer (heuristics) that can correct common mismatches (string->number coercion, iso8601 date parsing, trimming surrounding whitespace) and annotate responses with repair_diagnostics
Provide SDK spec: how to interpret envelope, how to opt into repair, and backwards-compatible behavior for older SDKs
Instrument telemetry to record per-field failure rates and repair success/failure; dashboard query available
Integration tests that cover: strict rejection, lenient accept+repair, and repaired-call audit logging
Feature gated rollout with gradual enablement and a kill-switch for customer safety
telemetry_queries: sum(failures) by (field_path, error_code) over 7d: detects most frequent mismatches
ratio(successful_repairs, total_repairs) by heuristic over 30d: safety signal
rollout_plan: Start behind feature-flag beta for internal and 5 pilot customers for 2 weeks. Monitor repair success and customer errors; if >0.5% of repaired calls regress in quality, disable auto-repair. After pilot, enable lenient mode by default and strict mode opt-in via model policy; release SDK updates that expose diagnostic envelope parsing.
testing_plan: Unit tests for validator: coverage for JSON schema types, enums, nested arrays/objects, required vs optional
Property tests that fuzz common user payloads and assert repair idempotence
E2E with SDK: simulate older SDKs that don't understand envelope and ensure graceful fallback to previous error string
Performance regression tests: validate overhead of validation+repair on p50/p95 latency budgets
notes: Trade-offs considered: embedding suggested_fix free-text vs structured remediation; chose short string suggestions plus machine_tags to keep envelope compact
We considered extending OpenAPI-style validation; decided on lightweight, internal schema annotations to avoid coupling to external tools
Localization: human_message will be kept short; SDKs should be responsible for localization using machine_tags to map to i18n keys
